name: Madiran

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

notes: Madiran, from Tannat, is typically very concentrated and high in tannin.
It traditionally needs several years of aging to be at its best.

blurb.text: A South West France appellation of about 3,200 acres, spread over three départements, for red wine built on Tannat, with Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Fer and Manseng Noir in smaller roles. White Pacherenc du Vic-Bilh comes from the same area.
